name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
definition: Qwen3-30B-A3B is a efficient text Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model developed by Qwen / Alibaba in the Qwen3 family. It has 30.5B parameters with 3.3B/token active parameters, supports 32,768 native · 131,072 with YaRN of context, accepts Text and produces Text. Its primary role is efficient reasoning, multilingual inference and tool-oriented assistants.

key_topics: efficient reasoning, multilingual inference and tool-oriented assistants

details: 128 experts with 8 activated experts per token
GQA with 32 query heads and 4 KV heads
Sparse MoE design with only ~3.3B active parameters

training.summary: The Qwen3-30B-A3B checkpoint is designed to keep per-token compute low relative to its total parameter pool while retaining Qwen3 reasoning and multilingual capabilities. Post-training enables both deliberate thinking and low-latency direct response modes.

license.legal_note: OpenWeightModels summary for technical comparison; not legal advice.

deployments.notes: Community and publisher quantizations can further reduce weight memory.

hardware.summary: The 30.5B total size makes this MoE much more accessible than giant sparse models. However, 3.3B active parameters should still not be interpreted as a 3B storage footprint; all experts remain part of the checkpoint.

limitations: Active 3.3B describes compute routing, not total storage.
YaRN extension should be evaluated separately for long-context quality.
Thinking-mode output can dominate latency on reasoning workloads.
Runtime support for sparse MoE kernels can affect throughput more than raw active-parameter count suggests.
